review_manifest.full_page_review_source: five bounded page-group JPEG proxies plus two bounded formula/visual crop proxies
transport_notes: Exactly one bounded JPEG was returned per image call.
No original full-page PNG entered model context.
All seven proxies fit one guarded context segment below 4 MiB.
The text layer covered all 20 pages; detail crops reconciled formula and visual fidelity.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: It reveals what the authors considered decision-critical before the body.
visual_records.exact_reading: The Summary sheet places problem clarification, assumptions, model design, 73%/87% rates, tau 0.86, leader output, and limitations in a single evidence ladder.
visual_records.next_action: Bind each claim to its later formula, table, figure, or warning.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: The visual makes label scarcity and mixed-network context visible.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 1 shows 83 people, known conspirators in red, known non-conspirators in blue, and a larger unlabeled background.
visual_records.next_action: Freeze node identity, edge direction, time, and label provenance.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: These formulas define three of the five classifier features.
visual_records.exact_reading: The page presents degree, betweenness, and closeness features with printed normalizations.
visual_records.next_action: Reconcile disconnected paths, direction, and standard normalization choices.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: The graphic turns a behavioral premise into a node feature.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 2 places labeled people on concentric possession-rate rings from 0 to 1.
visual_records.next_action: Audit label leakage, denominator, and whether direction or message frequency changes the feature.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: It grounds the message-content feature and later semantic dictionary.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 1 marks suspicious topics 7, 11, and 13 across known-conspirator message pairs.
visual_records.next_action: Preserve sender, receiver, repeated topics, and discarded topic-16 provenance.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: It binds features to a fitted internal probability.
visual_records.exact_reading: The cluster shows the sigmoid, MAP objective, L2 log-loss, and gradient update.
visual_records.next_action: Check scaling, optimization direction, convergence, calibration, and threshold.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: It is the paper's main small-label validation chain.
visual_records.exact_reading: The cluster freezes each 14-case fold, averages training and held-out errors over 15 rounds, and selects lambda by held-out error.
visual_records.next_action: Require fold predictions, class balance, nested selection, variance, and uncertainty.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: The table turns fitted scores into an investigation priority.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 2 ranks Dolores 0.555, Crystal 0.508, and Jerome 0.388 at the top of the displayed unidentified list.
visual_records.next_action: Keep score direction, manager identity rule, calibration, and action threshold explicit.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: The shape contextualizes named manager scores rather than showing only ranks.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 3 shows a steep head and long tail, with three managers highlighted on the same curve.
visual_records.next_action: Report uncertainty and avoid treating visual separation as class confirmation.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: It exposes the human-to-machine semantic handoff.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 4 routes known suspicious messages through an expert dictionary to mark undetermined messages as new suspicious or non-suspicious cases.
visual_records.next_action: Version dictionary words, annotation rules, ambiguity review, and leakage controls.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: The returned resource is interpreted as topic similarity.
visual_records.exact_reading: The formulas define topic-word incidence and a two-fold resource flow back to topics.
visual_records.next_action: Reconcile indices, degree-zero cases, token frequency, normalization, and score semantics.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: The table should determine which semantic topic enters the retrained classifier.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 3 gives topics 11, 7, and 13 scores 0.750, 0.667, and 0.667; topic 5 is 0.417; topics including 4 are shown at zero.
visual_records.next_action: Resolve the prose's topic-4 append against the zero-score table before reuse.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: The formulas define the separate leadership estimand pipeline.
visual_records.exact_reading: The page shows ground-node voting and the suspicious-topic subgraph condition before edge reversal.
visual_records.next_action: Audit neighbor-score indexing, set notation, graph filtering, and convergence.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: It nominates a leader independently of logistic probability ordering.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 4 ranks Yao 2.67, Alex 2.21, Paul 1.92, and Elsie 1.62.
visual_records.next_action: Obtain external leader labels and compare unreversed, reversed, and alternative rankings.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: The visual checks a literature-derived leader profile.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 5 places Yao at relatively high betweenness and low degree compared with displayed conspirators and high-probability nodes.
visual_records.next_action: Treat the match as same-network support, not independent validation.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: It supplies concrete before-after evidence before a single rank statistic.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 5 shows seven old top-10 members remaining top-10 while others move to ranks 12, 14, and 16; individual probabilities also increase.
visual_records.next_action: Separate rank retention, score movement, threshold crossings, and person-level harms.

visual_records.exact_reading: The formula normalizes concordant minus discordant pairs by n(n-1)/2 and the paper reports tau 0.86.
visual_records.next_action: Check ties, candidate-set consistency, uncertainty, and action stability.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Together the plots distinguish rank agreement from score inflation.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 6 keeps tau above about 0.80 at independent error probability 0.5, while Figure 7 places most new probabilities above the old-equals-new diagonal.
visual_records.next_action: Reproduce the simulation, add correlated errors and intervals, and audit calibration and threshold movement.
